events.name: Bash
events.head: Check lane code state and live lanes status
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git log --oneline -3 -- cloud/src/lane.ts; git status --short cloud/src/lane.ts app/scripts/probe-lanes.mjs; git log origin/main --oneline -1; grep -n "lanes" cloud/src/index.ts | head -20; wc -l cloud/src/lane.ts; python3 workshop-plan/tasks/centre_admin.py GET /admin/api/lanes 2>&1 | head -c 1500

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find admin routes for Tantra reads
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n 'res === "tantra\|tantra-proxy\|tantra_proxy\|res === "lanes"' cloud/src/index.ts | head; sed -n 846,870p cloud/src/index.ts; grep -n "t061" scripts/walkthroughs/REVERT_LEDGER.md | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read both lane campaigns from Tantra via proxy
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; for id in 6acc0c7f5f16ab824d7a3487 6acc0c805f16ab824d7a34a1; do python3 workshop-plan/tasks/centre_admin.py GET /admin/api/tantra-proxy/email-campaigns/$id 2>&1 | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);d=d.get('data',d) if isinstance(d,dict) else d;print({k:d.get(k) for k in ['name','status','selectedSenderAccountIds','contactListIds','tags']}, {k:v for k,v in d.items() if 'count' in k.lower() or 'stat' in k.lower() or 'total' in k.lower()})"; done

events.text: Both lane campaigns are confirmed live as draft campaigns with no sender. Next I'm re-running the local lane probe.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find simulator stack setup
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rln "18892" cloud/scripts app/scripts workshop-plan/ops 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "argv\|port\|SIM_PORT" cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head -8; lsof -ti:18890,18892 | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Look for stack start instructions
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 1,14p app/scripts/probe-nurture.mjs | grep -i "wrangler\|sim\|run" ; grep -n "SIM_URL" cloud/wrangler.toml cloud/.dev.vars 2>/dev/null | sed 's/=.*/=.../' | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start private simulator and local centre
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; export SIM_STATE=/tmp/t061v-sim.json SIM_PORT=18892; rm -f $SIM_STATE; nohup python3 scripts/vendor-sim.py > /tmp/t061v-sim.log 2>&1 & echo SIM $!; rm -rf /tmp/t061v-d1; npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to /tmp/t061v-d1 2>&1 | tail -2; nohup npx wrangler dev --port 18890 --persist-to /tmp/t061v-d1 --var SIM_URL:http://127.0.0.1:18892 --var PUBLIC_URL:http://127.0.0.1:18890 > /tmp/t061v-dev.log 2>&1 & echo DEV $!

events.name: Bash
events.head: Wait for centre and run lane probe
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:18890/ 2>/dev/null | grep -q "[23]0" && break; sleep 2; done; tail -3 /tmp/t061v-dev.log; CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:18890 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:18892 node scripts/probe-lanes.mjs 2>&1 | tail -12

events.name: Bash
events.head: Count passes, check getSettings and sim list import
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:18890 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:18892 node app/scripts/probe-lanes.mjs 2>&1 | grep -c ^PASS; grep -n "export async function getSettings" -A6 cloud/src/*.ts | head -10; grep -n "listName\|isNewList\|duplicate\|already exists" cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head
